headline: A globe built for exploring live layers.
linkedin:
I built God's Eye View as an interactive, browser-based 3D globe for exploring live, open-source spatial data across different layers.

Because the globe pulls in external feeds, access to certain layers is tied directly to third-party API availability. The project is open source and structured to let you inspect how the spatial layers are brought together.

Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/gods-eye-view
instagram:
God's Eye View is a browser-based 3D globe built to navigate live, open-source spatial data layers. Keep in mind that some layers depend on third-party API access and uptime to render.

You can view the source code here: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/gods-eye-view
